gameName: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea)

steps.text: Game board on its {side} side
steps.note: Châteauma counts as a player for the board side
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: 24 silver coins, 26 workers and the white die beside the board
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Sort hex tiles by back: livestock, buildings, monasteries and black-backed tiles into their bags
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Castles, ships and mines in faceup piles by the board
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Mix the 4 extra hex tiles (2nd expansion) into the monastery and black supplies
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.13

steps.text: Mix the White Castles into the building, monastery and black supplies
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.14

steps.text: Shuffle the 42 goods tiles facedown; 5 stacks of 5 on phase spaces A-E; the other 17 aside
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Bonus tiles: 2 per colour on their spaces, the 5/6/7 tile on top
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Border post bonus tile on its slot
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.14

steps.text: Shields facedown on the depots' goods spaces, then flip them: {n}
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.17

steps.text: Vineyard depot by the board with the vineyard store beneath it (2-3 players: the side marked for them); double hex tiles in their bag
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.19

steps.text: Player board, 2 dice, turn order marker, VP marker and VP tile in your colour; a help sheet
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: A random duchy board{d}, side of your choice, on your player board under an overlay (first game: board 1 or 2 for everyone)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5 / p.13-14

steps.text: 3 random goods from the 17 aside onto your goods spaces (stack matching numbers); box the rest
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: 1 silver coin on your board
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: VP markers on the start of the track (between 1 and 100)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Everyone places 1 castle on a burgundy space of their duchy (first game with board 1 or 2: the space numbered 6)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: {n} random trade route tiles below your board in a row
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.14

steps.text: A vineyard board and 1 random vine bonus tile (from one set of 6)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.19

steps.text: Teams of 2 (seated together): a team board from halves 31a and 32a (advanced: 31b and 32b)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: Castle on the central burgundy space (advanced side: space 1 or 6)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: 3 random goods on the team goods spaces; 2 silver per team; workers: first team 3, second team 5
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: Each player still takes 2 dice, a turn order marker, VP marker and VP tile
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: Round 1 turn order: A1, B1, A2, B2
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: 1 silver, 2 workers, 3 random goods beside your board; the white die is yours
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: Solo duchy board (side 33 beginner, 34 advanced); a castle on any burgundy space
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: Your turn order marker on space 50 of the VP track as the target
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15

steps.text: Keep 1 goods tile of each type aside for Châteauma
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22

steps.text: Châteauma duchy board (side 35) by the main board, with one colour's pieces (it uses 1 die)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22

steps.text: Pick its difficulty (first game: Midweight, no modifiers)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22

steps.text: County cards 1-9 (Vineyards: 1 and 10-17): flip until one with a castle space, under the 1-4 slot; shuffle the rest under the leftmost slot and flip 1 under 5-6
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22 / p.24

steps.text: A castle on the 1-4 card's castle space; 1 goods of each type on its goods spaces; 1 silver; no workers
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22

steps.text: Workers change a die by 1 each (1 and 6 wrap around)
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.6

steps.text: Each phase: clear the depots, refill hex tiles, put the phase's 5 goods on the round spaces
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.6

steps.text: Depot spaces marked 4 are filled only with 4 players; 3BD gets a mine in phases B and D with 3 players
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.6

steps.text: Inns: put 1 next to the black depot each phase; max 1 inn per colour area
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.14

steps.text: Shields cost 1 silver each at the end of every phase
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.17

steps.text: Before each phase refill the vineyard depot and store from the bag
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.19

steps.text: Solo: fill all 37 spaces within 25 rounds
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.16

steps.text: Châteauma always plays last
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22

steps.text: Roll for start player (highest); workers by seat: 1, 2, 3, 4; turn order markers stacked in order; the start player takes the white die
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.5

steps.text: Roll all 3 dice to begin round 1
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.16

steps.text: You start; workers: 1 for you
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.22 / p.5

steps.text: Player A1 starts
steps.ref: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition rulebook (Awaken Realms / alea) p.15
